newsitem.title: KUWAIT: British royal yacht Britannia docks in Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: British royal yacht Britannia docks in Kuwait.

text.p: The British royal yacht Britannia, base for official visits by Prince Charles to three Arab Gulf states, has docked in Kuwait's Shuwaikh port, the British embassy said on Thursday.
Prince Charles is due in Kuwait on Friday for a two-day visit at the start of a three-station tour to Gulf Arab states including Bahrain and Qatar.
Britannia left Portsmouth, England in January on its final voyage to mark the end of British rule in Hong Kong on July 1, when the colony is handed back to China.

She will visit 17 countries before returning to Britain early in August, when for the last time she will take Queen Elizabeth and her family on their traditional summer cruise around the Western Isles of Scotland.
